subject: Automotive & EVs
title: The Rise of Ride-Hailing
description: A 60-second lesson on The Rise of Ride-Hailing.

hook.text: Uber launched in 2010, and within a decade more people in cities hailed rides than hailed cabs.

buildup.text: Ride-hailing apps matched idle car owners with passengers, creating a new layer of urban transportation.

discovery.text: In dense cities, ride-hailing reduced the need for car ownership—why own a car that sits idle 95 percent of the time?

twist.text: Studies show ride-hailing actually increased total miles driven in many cities, worsening congestion.

climax.text: The next step is autonomous ride-hailing—removing the driver to cut costs by 60 percent or more.

punchline.text: Ride-hailing proved people want access to cars, not ownership.

quiz.question: What unintended effect has ride-hailing had in some cities?
options: Increased total miles driven and congestion
